description: Score a CSV on completeness, type consistency and uniqueness, per column, and report the columns that are always empty, mostly empty, constant, or hold mixed types, plus duplicate rows. Choose this when you need a quick, reproducible quality assessment of a dataset: a score plus per-column completeness, uniqueness and type consistency. Do not choose this when you need the specific malformed rows listed (use csv-preflight), or when you need a module that produces a quality report inside your pipeline (use dataset-quality-report). Example requests: Profile this CSV and tell me which columns are unreliable. | Score this dataset export for quality before I trust it. | Which columns in this CSV are mostly empty or always the same value?

accepted_price.description: The amount accepted, exactly as quoted (for example "5.00" or 5). Checked against the stored quote, so a price that moved between quote and authorize is refused rather than silently absorbed. Optional, but sent to make the acceptance explicit.

authorized_by.description: Identifier of the human or agent authorizing this job.

content.description: The customer's input.csv, as text. Supported: CSV, TSV or any delimiter-separated text (comma, semicolon, tab, pipe). Maximum 1048576 bytes.

quote_id.description: The quote_id returned by POST /v1/jobs. Required to authorize a priced capability; the service rejects a priced job that does not name the quote it issued.

name: submit_csv_quality_report

access_token.description: Per-job credential. Present it as the X-Job-Token header to read the job or list it. Keep it; it is the only credential for this job.

verification.description: Independent verification. verification.ok = false means the job failed, not a partial success.

title: CSV data-quality report
